raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 0.0.16

package:
  name: merge3
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/merge3/merge3-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0852de4381cb46be5ef4ed49e3ac20c5a4a0cd46a8ff4bbb870bc27aab543306

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - merge3 = merge3.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python =${{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=61.2
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - merge3
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python =${{ python_min }}
    script:
      - pip check
      - merge3 --help

about:
  summary: Python implementation of 3-way merge
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  homepage: https://github.com/breezy-team/merge3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
